rationale: The original entry thesis relied on OCTV holding above its 5-minute 9-EMA, which has now failed as price dropped to $21.38 below the $21.41 moving average. With momentum rolling over and the daily loss budget tight, exiting now preserves capital rather than waiting for the $21.30 hard stop.
